title: anathallis caroli
intro: Anathallis caroli, commonly known as the orchid flower, is a plant species within the orchid family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The plant is believed to possess therapeutic actions that may help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and other respiratory problems. Bioactive constituents found in Anathallis caroli include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
